lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴着地面走。
lines.en: I keep low and hug the ground.

lines.zh: 脚步落在土上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My steps land softly on the soil.

lines.zh: 残影拖着，我绕到你背后。
lines.en: My afterimage trails as I slip behind you.
Ki scatters into thin mist at my feet.

lines.zh: 一步一步，缩短这段距离。
lines.en: Step by step, I close the distance.
Half floating, half walking, ready to launch.
My pauldron scrapes a stone wall.
I advance like a shadow.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑行，不出声。
lines.en: I glide along the ground without a sound.
I pause, then keep moving.
The grass slowly springs back behind me.
I know this ground well.
I crack my knuckles.
Ki pools behind me.
I wait for orders, or for prey.

lines.zh: 史拉格大人的命令，我只听这个。
lines.en: Lord Slug's order is the only one I hear.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，气在脚边散开。
lines.en: I skim the ground, ki scattering at my feet.
This sky is not mine.
I lower my head to check my armor.
With a target in sight, I never tire.
I count the wind's directions.
I remember many battles.
I raise my eyes to the distance.
Standing still is preparation too.
I check the crack in my wrist guard.
Weight low, ready to charge.
You. Stand still.
I'm sizing up your strength.
Your stance is poor.
I came for a fight.
You don't look like a warrior.

lines.zh: 史拉格的兵，气弹先开路。
lines.en: Slug's soldier opens with ki blasts.
Don't reach behind your waist.

lines.zh: 我看得清你的每一个动作。
lines.en: I see your every movement.
You yield a foot, I take a foot.
Don't rake me with that look.
If you want to fight, start now.
My master is stronger than you.
Your gear is worn out.
I've memorized your stance.
Look up when I speak.
You stand straight, but your legs tremble.

lines.zh: 你并不是史拉格要的人。
lines.en: You are not the one Lord Slug wants.
That patch under your feet will give.
A crack in my armor.
I grit my teeth, I don't retreat.
My armor cracked; I'm still standing.
Blood runs from my brow.
My breathing grew heavier.
A good hand, I admit.
That pain for one cut of yours.
I'm still steady.
I've learned your move.
Come, keep going.

lines.zh: 史拉格大人的兵，不捡食物。
lines.en: Lord Slug's soldier doesn't scavenge.
Would that buy a life?
Take it away, don't hinder me.
You want to distract me.
My hunger isn't mine to mind.
Too sweet a smell.
I won't touch your food.
I prefer something that can fight.
Toss it here, I'll crush it.
War leaves no room for such things.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的护甲。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my armor.
Don't block the corridor.
You hit my shoulder, and your hand goes numb.
I've known harder hits.
The bump hurt your hand, not me.
I don't dodge; I ram straight through.

lines.zh: 史拉格士兵，脚下从不打滑。
lines.en: Slug's soldier never slips.
A new scratch on my pauldron.
Once more and I'll strike.
Don't come near my back.
There is no room for that on the battlefield.
My only companions are weapons.
War never gave me time for that.
I only take orders from Lord Slug.

lines.zh: 我效忠的对象只有一个。
lines.en: I serve only one.
Such things weaken a warrior.

lines.zh: 史拉格大人没教过我这个。
lines.en: Lord Slug never taught me this.
Don't bring it up, it divides my focus.
I'm not that soft.
Let's talk after the fight.
This short rod fits my grip.
I pick it up out of habit.
What falls is mine.
This shard carries ki.
I flick it up with my foot.
Enough iron for a blade.
I tie it at my waist.
Another's things stay where they are.
I recognize the logo on this capsule.
Keep it, it may be useful.
You've been chosen as my opponent.
This distance will do.

lines.zh: 小气弹在指尖转，等个机会。
lines.en: A small ki blast spins on my fingertip.
Beginning the sweep.
I strike without gaps.
Don't run, it's disgraceful.
Ki blast, ready.
You're standing badly.
One strike is enough.
For my master.
You still have time to beg.

lines.zh: 你的气跑不出这个星球。
lines.en: Your ki won't escape this planet.
This won't take long.
Your allies can't save you.
I raise my hand; the ki blast is already away.
One push off the ground, and I come for you.
Ki blasts seal off your escape first.
My afterimage lingers in place.

lines.zh: 残影在原地，我已经到了。
lines.en: The afterimage stays; I've already arrived.
The ki blast's path is set.
Your footsteps have already broken rhythm.
This ground won't slow me.
One flicker and I am behind you.
I've left you an opening.
Don't think I fight only up close.
My breathing hasn't changed.
My afterimage slips around your left.
There's a seam in your armor.
Do you hear the ki?
I'm moving now.
This lands on your waist.
Don't count on a way out.

lines.zh: 你摸枪的动作我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you reach for your weapon.
This is as far as it goes.
My fist lands on your armor.
A knife hand cuts at your neck.
My knee drives into your flank.
A ki blast skims the ground.
I shove you into the wall.
That blow punched through planks.
I've locked your wrist.
I raise my arm for a follow-up.
This elbow goes under your ribs.
Don't stand there, retreat.
My strikes never linger.

lines.zh: 残影还在原地，我已经到了。
lines.en: My afterimage stays put; I'm already there.
Block it and your arm goes numb.
I'm hunting the vital spot.
Keep this up and you'll fall.
Enough of this.
I rise straight up from the ground.
My armor catches the light in the dark.

lines.zh: 这里有需要清扫的目标。
lines.en: There are targets here to clear.
I land, knees bending first.
Dust blooms around me.
I'm here, don't look for excuses.
I lower my ki.
I measure the distance.
I plant myself on this ground.
Mission start.
Mud on my boots.
My master sent me.
I fall out of the light.
This stretch belongs to us now.
Prepare to fight.

lines.zh: 史拉格的兵，拳头先说话。
lines.en: Slug's soldier lets his fists speak first.

lines.zh: 风停了，史拉格大人的命令到了。
lines.en: The wind stopped; Lord Slug's order has come.
Executing.
Flame licked my arm.
I landed hard, my knee jolted.
Water in my lungs, it burns.
The blast tore my pauldron open.
An arrow sticks in my chest.
Magic leaves me dizzy.
Hungry, my fists go soft.
Lightning hits and my muscles seize.

lines.zh: 虚空里，脚下没有着力点。
lines.en: In the void there's nothing to stand on.
